name: Cayo Miskito
note: Small population of about 50 individuals; one of the two known Central American populations, about 600 km from the Costa Rica–Panama one and probably isolated.

name: Punta Mona to Bocas del Toro Archipelago
note: Resident population from Punta Mona (Costa Rica) to the Changuinola River (Panama), mostly within about 3 km of shore.

name: Urabá to Morrosquillo
note: Small resident populations of Guiana and common bottlenose dolphins.

name: Maracaibo Lake System
note: Lake, strait and gulf system; the species is listed as Vulnerable nationally.

name: Guianas to Amazon Outflow
note: From the central Guianas to Maranhão, with the Amazon river dolphin; the species is listed as Endangered in French Guiana and Vulnerable in Brazil.

name: Manatee Estuarine Complex
note: Vaza Barris estuary and Piauí–Fundo–Real estuarine complex (Sergipe and Bahia), about 120 km²; Guiana dolphins also use the area.

name: Abrolhos Bank
note: Includes the only known offshore population (over 70 km from the coast); resident population in the Caravelas estuary studied by mark–recapture, 2002–2021.

name: Guanabara–Sepetiba Coastal Embayment Complex
note: Guanabara and Sepetiba bays (Rio de Janeiro).

name: Paranaguá–Cananéia Estuarine Embayments Complexes
note: Estuarine complexes of Cananéia (São Paulo) and Paranaguá (Paraná).

name: Babitonga Bay
note: Fewer than 200 animals near the southern limit of the range; probably the smallest population of the species.
